# Python API reference

`import MultiNEAT as NEAT` gives access to everything below. The guides explain how the pieces fit
together - start with the [tutorial](tutorial.md).

Lists returned by the library (`pop.Species`, `species.Individuals`, `genome.LinkGenes`,
`net.neurons`, ...) are *references* into the C++ objects: changing an element changes the object. They
support `len()`, indexing, iteration, `append()` etc. like Python lists, and Python lists and tuples are
accepted wherever such a list is expected.

*(This page is generated by `docs/tools/gen_api.py`.)*

### Population

A population of genomes divided into species - the evolutionary algorithm

```python
Population(seed_genome: Genome, params: Parameters, randomize_weights: bool, randomization_range: float, rng_seed: int)
Population(filename: str)
```

| Method | |
|---|---|
| `AccessGenomeByID(id: int) -> Genome` | A reference to the genome with this ID. |
| `AccessGenomeByIndex(index: int) -> Genome` | A reference to the genome with this index (counting through all species). |
| `Epoch() -> None` | Creates the next generation. All genomes must have their fitness set. |
| `GetBaseMPC() -> float` | The complexity at the start of the current complexifying phase. |
| `GetBestFitnessEver() -> float` | The best fitness seen during the whole run. |
| `GetBestGenome() -> Genome` | A copy of the best genome of the current population. |
| `GetCurrentMPC() -> float` | The mean population complexity (average number of links). |
| `GetGeneration() -> int` | The current generation number. |
| `GetMPCStagnation() -> int` | Generations since the complexity last decreased (simplifying phase). |
| `GetSearchMode() -> SearchMode` | The phase of the phased search: COMPLEXIFYING, SIMPLIFYING or BLENDED. |
| `GetStagnation() -> int` | Generations since the best fitness last improved. |
| `InitPhenotypeBehaviorData(behaviors: PhenotypeBehaviorList, archive: PhenotypeBehaviorList) -> None` | C++ novelty search: assigns one PhenotypeBehavior to every genome and sets the archive. |
| `NoveltySearchTick(successful_genome: Genome) -> bool` | C++ novelty search: one Tick() with novelty as fitness. Returns True if a successful behavior was found. |
| `NumGenomes() -> int` | The number of genomes in the population. |
| `Save(filename: str) -> None` | Saves the parameters, the innovation database and all genomes to a text file. |
| `Tick(removed_genome: Genome) -> Genome` | Steady-state evolution: replaces the worst evaluated genome (copied into removed_genome) with one new baby and returns the baby. The returned genome is valid until the next Tick() or Epoch(). |

**Attributes:** `ID`, `Parameters`, `RNG`, `Species`

### RNG

A random number generator (Mersenne Twister)

```python
RNG()
```

| Method | |
|---|---|
| `RandFloat() -> float` | A random number in [0, 1). |
| `RandFloatSigned() -> float` | A random number in (-1, 1), small values are more likely. |

| `Seed(seed: int) -> None` |  |
| `TimeSeed() -> None` | Seeds from a hardware random source and the clock. |

## Genomes

### Genome

A genome - the genetic description of a neural network

```python
Genome()
Genome(filename: str)
Genome(params: Parameters, init_struct: GenomeInitStruct)
Genome(ID: int, NumInputs: int, NumHidden: int, NumOutputs: int, FS_NEAT: bool, OutputActType: ActivationFunction, HiddenActType: ActivationFunction, SeedType: int, params: Parameters, NumLayers: int = 0, FS_NEAT_links: int = 1)
```

| Method | |
|---|---|
| `BuildESHyperNEATPhenotype(net: NeuralNetwork, substrate: Substrate, params: Parameters) -> None` | Uses this genome as a CPPN to build an ES-HyperNEAT network (the hidden neurons are discovered). |
| `BuildHyperNEATPhenotype(net: NeuralNetwork, substrate: Substrate) -> None` | Uses this genome as a CPPN to build a HyperNEAT network on the substrate. |
| `BuildPhenotype(net: NeuralNetwork) -> None` | Builds the neural network this genome encodes into net. |
| `CalculateDepth() -> None` | Computes the longest feed-forward path from the inputs to the outputs. |
| `CompatibilityDistance(other: Genome, params: Parameters) -> float` | The compatibility distance used for speciation. |
| `DerivePhenotypicChanges(net: NeuralNetwork) -> None` | Copies the weights of a network built from this genome back into the genome. |
| `FailsConstraints(params: Parameters) -> bool` | True if the genome has dead ends, no links, forbidden loops or fails CustomConstraints. |
| `GetAdjFitness() -> float` | The fitness after fitness sharing. |
| `GetDepth() -> int` | The depth computed by CalculateDepth(). |
| `GetFitness() -> float` |  |
| `GetGenomeTraits() -> dict` | The genome traits as a dict. |
| `GetID() -> int` |  |
| `GetLinkTraits(with_weights: bool = False) -> list` | A list of (from ID, to ID, {trait: value}[, weight]). |
| `GetNeuronTraits() -> list` | A list of (neuron ID, type, {trait: value}). |
| `HasDeadEnds() -> bool` | True if a hidden neuron has no inputs or no outputs. |
| `HasLoops() -> bool` | True if the network has cycles. |
| `IsCompatibleWith(other: Genome, params: Parameters) -> bool` | True if the distance is below the compatibility threshold. |
| `IsEvaluated() -> bool` |  |
| `Mutate_GenomeTraits(params: Parameters, rng: RNG) -> bool` |  |
| `Mutate_LinkTraits(params: Parameters, rng: RNG) -> bool` |  |
| `Mutate_LinkWeights(params: Parameters, rng: RNG) -> bool` |  |
| `Mutate_NeuronActivation_Type(params: Parameters, rng: RNG) -> bool` |  |
| `Mutate_NeuronActivations_A(params: Parameters, rng: RNG) -> bool` |  |
| `Mutate_NeuronActivations_B(params: Parameters, rng: RNG) -> bool` |  |
| `Mutate_NeuronBiases(params: Parameters, rng: RNG) -> bool` |  |
| `Mutate_NeuronTimeConstants(params: Parameters, rng: RNG) -> bool` |  |
| `Mutate_NeuronTraits(params: Parameters, rng: RNG) -> bool` |  |
| `NumInputs() -> int` | The number of inputs (including the bias). |
| `NumLinks() -> int` | The number of link genes. |
| `NumNeurons() -> int` | The number of neuron genes. |
| `NumOutputs() -> int` | The number of outputs. |
| `PrintAllTraits() -> None` | Prints the traits of the genome, its neurons and links. |
| `Randomize_LinkWeights(params: Parameters, rng: RNG) -> None` | Sets all weights to random values in [MinWeight, MaxWeight]. |
| `Randomize_Traits(params: Parameters, rng: RNG) -> None` | Sets all traits to random values. |
| `ResetEvaluated() -> None` |  |
| `Save(filename: str) -> None` | Saves the genome to a text file (without traits). |
| `SetEvaluated() -> None` | Marks the genome as evaluated (needed for steady-state evolution). |

| `SetID(id: int) -> None` |  |

## Networks

### NeuralNetwork

A neural network - the phenotype built from a genome

```python
NeuralNetwork()
NeuralNetwork(minimal: bool)
```
minimal=False creates a small XOR network for testing

| Method | |
|---|---|
| `Activate() -> None` | Activates once - the signals move one connection further. |
| `ActivateFast() -> None` | Activates once, assuming unsigned sigmoid neurons everywhere. |
| `ActivateLeaky(dt: float) -> None` | Activates leaky integrator neurons for a time step dt. |
| `ActivateUseInternalBias() -> None` | Like Activate(), but adds each neuron's bias to its input. |
| `Adapt(params: Parameters) -> None` | Hebbian learning step. |
| `AddConnection(connection: Connection) -> None` |  |
| `AddNeuron(neuron: Neuron) -> None` |  |
| `Clear() -> None` | Removes all neurons and connections. |
| `Flush() -> None` | Resets all activations. |
| `FlushCube() -> None` | Resets the RTRL sensitivities. |
| `FlushCude() -> None` |  |
| `GetTotalConnectionLength() -> float` | The number of connections. |
| `InitRTRLMatrix() -> None` | Allocates the data for RTRL learning. |
| `Input(inputs: object) -> None` | Sets the inputs. Accepts any sequence of numbers (list, tuple, numpy array). |
| `Load(filename: str) -> bool` | Loads a network saved with Save(). Returns False if the file is missing or malformed. |
| `NumInputs() -> int` |  |
| `NumOutputs() -> int` |  |
| `Output() -> DoublesList` | The activations of the output neurons. |
| `RTRL_update_error(target: float) -> None` | RTRL: accumulates the weight changes for the target value of the first output. |
| `RTRL_update_gradients() -> None` | RTRL: updates the sensitivities after an activation. |
| `RTRL_update_weights() -> None` | RTRL: applies the accumulated weight changes. |
| `Save(filename: str) -> None` | Saves the network to a text file. |
| `SetInputOutputDimentions(inputs: int, outputs: int) -> None` |  |

**Attributes:** `connections`, `neurons`

## Novelty search

### PhenotypeBehavior

Base class of behaviors for the C++ novelty search (can be subclassed in Python)

```python
PhenotypeBehavior()
```

| Method | |
|---|---|
| `Acquire(genome: Genome) -> bool` | Override: evaluates the genome and records its behavior. Return True if it was successful. |
| `Distance_To(other: PhenotypeBehavior) -> float` | Override: the distance to another behavior. |
| `Successful() -> bool` | Override: True if this is the behavior we are looking for. |

**Attributes:** `m_Data`

## Enumerations

* `ActivationFunction`: `SIGNED_SIGMOID`, `UNSIGNED_SIGMOID`, `TANH`, `TANH_CUBIC`, `SIGNED_STEP`, `UNSIGNED_STEP`, `SIGNED_GAUSS`, `UNSIGNED_GAUSS`, `ABS`, `SIGNED_SINE`, `UNSIGNED_SINE`, `LINEAR`, `RELU`, `SOFTPLUS`
* `NeuronType`: `NONE`, `INPUT`, `BIAS`, `HIDDEN`, `OUTPUT`
* `SearchMode`: `COMPLEXIFYING`, `SIMPLIFYING`, `BLENDED`
* `GenomeSeedType`: `PERCEPTRON`, `LAYERED`

The values are compatible with integers, e.g. `int(NEAT.ActivationFunction.TANH)`.

## Functions

| Function | |
|---|---|
| `GetGenomeList(pop)` | Returns all genomes of the population as a list. The genomes are references - changing their fitness changes the population. |
| `ZipFitness(genome_list, fitness_list)` | Sets the fitness of every genome and marks it as evaluated. |
| `EvaluateGenomeList_Serial(genome_list, evaluator, display=True, show_elapsed=False)` | Evaluates the genomes one after another and returns the list of fitness values. evaluator is a callable that takes a Genome and returns its fitness. |
| `EvaluateGenomeList_Parallel(genome_list, evaluator, cores=None, display=True, ipython_client=None)` | Evaluates the genomes in parallel processes and returns the list of fitness values. evaluator is a callable that takes a Genome and returns its fitness. It must be picklable (defined at the top level of a module). The genomes are pickled together with their traits. Uses concurrent.futures with `cores` processes (all CPUs by default), or an IPython cluster when an ipyparallel Client is given. |
| `Draw(x, size=(300, 300), substrate=False)` | Returns an image (NumPy uint8 array) of a NeuralNetwork or a Genome's phenotype. |
| `DrawPhenotype(image, rect, nn, neuron_radius=15, max_line_thickness=3, substrate=False)` | Draws a network into a NumPy image within rect = (x, y, width, height) using OpenCV. With substrate=True the neurons are drawn at their substrate coordinates. |
| `plot_nn(nn, ax=None, is_substrate=False, details=False, invert_yaxis=True, connection_alpha=1.0)` | Draws a NeuralNetwork or a Genome's phenotype with Matplotlib. |
| `render_nn(nn, ax=None, is_substrate=False, details=False, invert_yaxis=True, connection_alpha=1.0)` | Draws an already laid out NeuralNetwork into a Matplotlib axis. |
| `Genome2NX(g, with_inputs=False, with_weights=False)` | Converts a genome to a networkx DiGraph with the traits as node and edge attributes. |

Space()
